text: {"lessons":["Selling some Stock A realized gains and reduced my exposure, but those sales alone cannot tell me whether my timing was good; I should base future trades on a clear plan.","After selling, I left the portfolio untouched through several ups and downs, so I should review it periodically and rebalance when it no longer fits my goals—not simply ignore it.","Short-term account changes do not show whether my strategy is working; I should judge progress over a longer horizon and consider the portfolio as a whole."]}
